For the meeting of the Reserve Bank Board held on 4 August 2026

Risks around the outlook

The risks around the outlook are broadly balanced. International developments remain a key uncertainty.

The economic outlook

GDP growth is expected to be 1.6 per cent in 2026. The Australian economy continues to expand at a modest pace.

Inflation

Inflation is expected to be 2.8 per cent in 2026. Services price inflation remains elevated.

The labour market

The labour market has remained tight. Wage growth is expected to be 3.5 per cent in 2026.

Forward guidance

The Board will continue to monitor global economic developments. The Board is not ruling anything in or out regarding the future path of interest rates.
